Three.js 0.128.0 and its matching legacy GLTFLoader, copied from the official `three@0.128.0` npm package. MIT license in THREE-LICENSE. The game keeps its existing r128 renderer API; the independent 3D Studio uses its own r186 module bundle.

GLTFLoader is loaded only when the Pip character flag is enabled. The core is local so loading the game no longer depends on a Three.js CDN response.
